study_type_evidence.quote: We performed an in vivo PK rat study to evaluate the half-life of the antagonist TB01-3 and agonist TB59-2 in IgG format.
They display functional activity in vitro in cell signaling assays

in_vivo_species.quote: there are 5 rats used in each group, the error bars are plotted as the SD
They display functional activity in vitro in cell signaling assays and in vivo in healthy wild-type mice.

in_vitro_detail: GLP-1 R binding and cell signalling assays for a panel of 13 antibodies.

agents.name: TB01-3 (antagonist IgG)
agents.sequence_source: Not printed in the body. PEPlife2's string is a short motif-length sequence, but the dosed agent is a full IgG - the body says the antibodies were evaluated 'in IgG format'.
agents.group_n_quote: there are 5 rats used in each group
agents.pk_quote: In a 2-week PK study, TB01-3 exhibited an antibody-like in vivo half-life of ~1-week in rats

agents.name: TB59-2 (agonist GLP-1 peptide-antibody fusion)
agents.sequence_source: Not printed in the body. PEPlife2's string is the fused GLP-1 peptide, not the antibody it is fused to.
agents.group_n_quote: there are 5 rats used in each group

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: TB01-3 has a fast-alpha phase and an equilibrium beta phase. based on the beta phase calculation, TB01-3 has a 1-week half-life in rat. (b) TB59-2 has a 2-day half-life in rat.
concentration_time_figure.note: 2-week study; the reported half-lives are beta-phase values.

bioanalytical_method: ELISA per PEPlife2's Assay field; the body does not describe the bioanalysis
notes: Both values verified against the Results and the Figure 11 caption: TB01-3 ~1 week and TB59-2 >2 days, n = 5 rats per group. Three caveats. (1) THE DOSED AGENTS ARE ANTIBODIES, not peptides - the body evaluates them 'in IgG format' - and the ~1-week half-life is explicitly attributed to antibody behaviour ('an antibody-like in vivo half-life', driven by FcRn recycling as the Introduction explains). PEPlife2 stores a 39-residue and a 30-residue motif against those labels, so the representation is a fragment of the molecule while the label belongs to the whole IgG. (2) Both values are approximate or bounded, not point estimates: '~1-week' and '>2-day'. PEPlife2 stores them as '~1' week and '>2' days, and the half-life parser takes the first number, so the open lower bound on TB59-2 becomes the fixed value 48 h. (3) The body reports no dose and no route for the rat PK study. For scale the paper notes liraglutide's half-life is 13 h.
